headline: Binance Takes In 294.9 Million Dollars As Exchange Flows Reverse To A 240.3 Million Dollar Inflow
narrative: Exchanges took in 240.3 million dollars over 24 hours, 0.0898 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and Binance took in 294.9 million dollars while OKX shed 108.2 million. Bybit took in 48.3 million dollars and Gate took in 38.5 million, while Bitget shed 45.7 million.
author: jordan
